events.title: Howard Carter Discovers Entrance to Tutankhamun's Tomb
events.description: British archaeologist Howard Carter's team uncovered the first step leading down to the tomb of Pharaoh Tutankhamun in the Valley of the Kings, Egypt. The full entrance was cleared over the following days, and the tomb was officially opened in 1923.
events.significance: The find was the most intact royal Egyptian tomb ever discovered, sparking worldwide fascination with ancient Egypt and transforming modern archaeology.

events.title: Iran Hostage Crisis Begins
events.description: Militant Iranian students, supporting the Islamic Revolution, stormed the U.S. Embassy in Tehran and took 66 Americans hostage. 52 of them were held for 444 days, until January 1981.
events.significance: The crisis reshaped U.S.-Iran relations, damaged Jimmy Carter's presidency, and influenced American foreign policy in the Middle East for decades.

events.title: Barack Obama Elected President of the United States
events.description: Senator Barack Obama of Illinois defeated Republican John McCain in the U.S. presidential election, winning both the electoral and popular vote.
events.significance: Obama became the first African American elected U.S. president, marking a historic milestone in American history and the civil rights struggle.

events.title: Soviet Forces Crush the Hungarian Revolution
events.description: Soviet troops launched a large-scale military assault on Budapest to suppress the Hungarian uprising against Soviet-imposed policies. Thousands of Hungarians were killed and about 200,000 fled the country.
events.significance: The crackdown demonstrated Soviet determination to maintain control over Eastern Europe and the limits of de-Stalinization, shaping Cold War dynamics.

events.title: Assassination of Israeli Prime Minister Yitzhak Rabin
events.description: Rabin was shot and killed by Yigal Amir, a right-wing Israeli extremist, at a peace rally in Tel Aviv in support of the Oslo Accords.
events.significance: Rabin's death was a major blow to the Israeli-Palestinian peace process and deeply affected Israeli politics and society.
